question: Can the pinned onset thermodynamic coefficient pack be extracted without sparse-history interpolation bias, while explicitly partitioning the frozen k grid into TCA-on and TCA-off modes according to the source-locked compromise_CLASS trigger?

method.histories: regenerate the same nine read-only pinned CLASS histories as C10.65e
method.exact_onset_anchor: for each mode search raw rows for |a-a_on|/a_on <= 1e-12; do not interpolate thermodynamic coefficients for the certified common pack
method.common_pack: form the pack only from exact-onset anchor rows and require their k-independent thermodynamic primitives to agree
method.tca_partition: derive k_TCA=trigger_k/tau_c from the certified common pack and evaluate the source-locked pair of TCA trigger inequalities for every frozen k
method.exported_flag_check: compare the predicted on/off partition against the nearest-onset exported tca_flag for each mode; infer the numeric enum values from the observed low-k/high-k partition rather than hard-coding them

acceptance: at least three frozen histories must contain an exact onset anchor row at relative a tolerance <=1e-12
R, cb2, dkappa, ddkappa, tau_c, dtau_c, F and F_prime must be finite and satisfy R>0, 0<=cb2<1, dkappa>0, tau_c>0, F>0
within the exact-anchor subset, relative spread of R,cb2,dkappa,ddkappa,tau_c,dtau_c,F,F_prime and Hc must be <=1e-10
within the exact-anchor subset, algebraic reconstructions of tau_c,dtau_c,F,F_prime and tau_c/tau_h must agree with exports to <=1e-12 relative
the common pack must satisfy tau_c/tau_h<0.015
derive and report k_TCA=0.01/tau_c; do not require all nine frozen modes to lie below it
predicted TCA on/off partition over the nine frozen k values must agree with exported tca_flag states at the nearest onset rows
the rank-seed domain must contain at least the first three low-k modes and must approach the k->0 tight-coupling branch
report the first frozen mode outside TCA, if any, as a regime boundary rather than a model failure
next_if_pass: freeze and implement C10.65g corrected completed-U1 O(k^2) superhorizon coefficient/rank solver using Delta I_iso=0, the exact-onset low-k TCA pack, the source-locked hierarchy and the preferred DAE metric projector; solve V_khr0 and B0 rather than prescribing them
non_claims: not a claim that TCA applies to the full finite-k grid
